name: lena-rest-look-four-reveal-deep-ranger-rest-bottom
notes: Lena, Dorumegia's Herald (gwve1d47o7): the only Ranger ally (Hidden Longbowman) is the 4th of the top four, followed by a Charge the Soul marker as the 5th card. It can only be offered if all four were looked at; it goes to hand and the other three go to the bottom in their original order. Pre-fix only the top card was looked at.

rulesClauses: Look at the top four cards of your deck. You may reveal a Ranger ally card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The generated activateAbilityAbilities["gwve1d47o7:0"] body looked at the top four cards with a loop of MZMove($player, "myDeck-0", "myTempZone"): Remove() only flags a slot removed (no splice), so "myDeck-0" re-resolved to the SAME removed slot on every iteration after the first and MZMove's already-removed guard silently no-oped -- only the top card was ever looked at (a Ranger ally deeper than the first card was never offered). Also the "may reveal" follow-up CUSTOM was added without dontSkipOnPass, so declining (PASS) skipped EnhanceHearingFinish and stranded the looked-at card in myTempZone. The generated file cannot be edited (gitignored), so the closure is overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php with MZMoveTopOfZone() and dontSkipOnPass:1.
